info.title: Audiobook Librarian API
info.description:
API documentation for the Audiobook Librarian application.

This specification covers all endpoints available in the Audiobook Librarian API v1. Authentication uses opaque Bearer tokens returned by the login endpoint.

BearerAuth.description: Authentication using Bearer tokens. After logging in, include the token in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
